heading.zh-Hant: 出身、海軍軍官與當選挪威國王
heading.en: Birth, naval career and election as king of Norway

body.zh-Hant: 哈康七世原為丹麥王子卡爾，1872年8月3日生於夏洛滕隆。他受海軍軍官教育，1893年任少尉、1896年升中尉，並於1896年7月22日在倫敦白金漢宮與表妹茉德成婚。1905年挪威與瑞典解除聯盟後，挪威議會於11月18日一致選他為國王，11月25日他與王后抵達克里斯蒂安尼亞（今奧斯陸），1906年6月22日在特隆赫姆大教堂加冕。
body.en: Haakon VII was born Prince Carl of Denmark on 3 August 1872 at Charlottenlund. Trained as a naval officer, he became a second lieutenant in 1893 and a first lieutenant in 1896, and on 22 July 1896 married his cousin Maud at Buckingham Palace in London. After the union with Sweden was dissolved in 1905, the Storting unanimously elected him king on 18 November; he and the queen reached Kristiania (Oslo) on 25 November and were crowned at Trondheim cathedral on 22 June 1906.

heading.en: A constitutional monarch and the first Labour government

body.zh-Hant: 丹麥傳記辭典稱他與議會、政府的關係嚴格依憲法，並贏得普遍信任。第一次世界大戰期間，他是政府在對英國銅供應爭端上的重要顧問，也出席了1914年馬爾默與1917年克里斯蒂安尼亞的三王會晤。1928年1月，他讓當時仍具革命色彩的工黨在選舉獲勝後首次組閣，這項主動作為後來影響了工黨對王權的態度；1935年約翰·尼高斯沃爾以工黨領袖身分出任首相時，這份信任發揮了作用。
body.en: The Danish biographical dictionary says his relations with the Storting and the government were strictly constitutional and that he won universal trust. During the First World War he was a valuable adviser to his government in the dispute with Britain over copper deliveries, and he took part in the three-kings meetings at Malmö in 1914 and Kristiania in 1917. In January 1928 he let the still revolutionary Labour Party form its first government after its election victory, an initiative that later shaped Labour's attitude to the monarchy; the trust this created proved useful when Johan Nygaardsvold became prime minister in 1935.

heading.en: The April 1940 invasion and the King's refusal

body.zh-Hant: 1940年4月9日德軍進攻挪威，國王隨政府與議會前往哈馬爾，議會當晚在埃勒魯姆授權政府代表議會作決定。4月10日德國公使布勞爾要求任命吉斯林為政府首腦，國王拒絕，並表示若政府另有看法，他願意退位，政府與他意見一致。4月11日他與政府在尼貝格松遭德機猛烈轟炸，23日抵達莫爾德；6月7日他自特羅姆瑟乘船赴英國，6月10日抵達倫敦。
body.en: When the German attack on Norway began on 9 April 1940, the King followed the government and the Storting to Hamar, and that night at Elverum the Storting gave the government full powers. On 10 April the German envoy Curt Bräuer demanded that Vidkun Quisling be appointed head of government; the King refused and said he was ready to abdicate if the government took a different view, but the government agreed with him. On 11 April he and the government were heavily bombed at Nybergsund; he reached Molde on 23 April, sailed from Tromsø for England on 7 June and arrived in London on 10 June.

body.zh-Hant: 國王在整個戰爭期間待在英國。1940年7月3日，他回覆受德方施壓的議會議長團，拒絕放棄憲法職權。9月25日，德國帝國專員特博文宣布國王與政府已被廢黜；倫敦方面則回應，將繼續戰鬥直到挪威成為自由國家。1945年6月7日，他結束五年流亡返回挪威，在奧斯陸受到熱烈歡迎。
body.en: The King remained in Britain throughout the war. On 3 July 1940 he answered the Storting presidium, which was under German pressure, with a clear refusal to give up his constitutional functions. On 25 September Reichskommissar Terboven declared the King and the government deposed, and from London they replied that they would continue the fight until Norway was a free country. On 7 June 1945, after five years in exile, the King returned to Norway and was given a jubilant welcome in Oslo.

heading.zh-Hant: 出身與南大河州政壇起步
heading.en: Origins and early career in Rio Grande do Sul

body.zh-Hant: 熱圖利奧·瓦加斯1882年4月19日生於南大河州聖博爾哈，年少時把出生年改為1883年，此事直到百年紀念時才被發現；德國國家圖書館權威檔與《拉丁美洲史與文化百科》作1883年。他1907年12月畢業於法學院，1908年1月被任命為波多阿雷格里法院第二檢察官；1909年3月以共和黨（PRR）名單當選州議會議員。1913年他再度當選，卻在10月開議時因與州長博爾熱斯·德梅代羅斯不合而辭職；1917年重返議會後，實際擔任PRR的議會領袖（無正式文件）。
body.en: Getúlio Vargas was born on 19 April 1882 at São Borja in Rio Grande do Sul and as a young man changed his birth year to 1883, which was discovered only during his centenary; the German National Library authority record and the Encyclopedia of Latin American History and Culture give 1883. He graduated in law in December 1907 and in January 1908 was appointed second public prosecutor of the Porto Alegre court; in March 1909 he was elected to the state assembly on the PRR ticket. Re-elected in 1913, he resigned at the opening session in October in disagreement with Governor Borges de Medeiros; after returning to the assembly in 1917 he acted as leader of the PRR there, without formal appointment.

heading.zh-Hant: 聯邦眾議員與財政部長

body.zh-Hant: 1922年10月，他被推舉並當選聯邦眾議員，補已故南大河州議員拉斐爾·卡貝達的缺；1924年連任後，他成為共和黨籍南大河州議員團的領袖。1926年5月他進入眾議院財政委員會。1926年11月15日華盛頓·路易斯就任總統，任命他為財政部長；他主要推動貨幣改革，恢復金本位並設立匯率穩定基金。這段部長任期只比一年多一點，1927年11月他當選南大河州州長，12月卸下財政部職務。
body.en: In October 1922 he was nominated and elected to the federal Chamber of Deputies to complete the term left vacant by the death of the Rio Grande do Sul deputy Rafael Cabeda; re-elected in 1924, he led the Rio Grande do Sul Republican bench. In May 1926 he joined the Chamber's Finance Committee. On 15 November 1926 Washington Luís took office as president and appointed him minister of finance; he mainly carried out the monetary reform, which restored the gold standard and created a stabilisation fund. His time at the ministry lasted little more than a year, and after being elected governor of Rio Grande do Sul in November 1927 he left the Finance Ministry in December.

heading.zh-Hant: 南大河州州長與1930年革命

body.zh-Hant: 1928年1月25日，瓦加斯就任南大河州「州總統」（即州長）。他任命奧斯瓦爾多·阿蘭哈為內政與司法廳長。1930年，他接受改革派自由聯盟（Aliança Liberal）的提名角逐總統，但在三月選舉中被各州鄉村政治機器擊敗。10月3日，革命在南大河州、米納斯吉拉斯與帕拉伊巴同時爆發；11月3日，瓦加斯就任臨時政府首長。
body.en: On 25 January 1928 Vargas took office as president (governor) of Rio Grande do Sul. He appointed Osvaldo Aranha to the Interior and Justice secretariat. In 1930 he accepted the nomination of the reformist Liberal Alliance for the presidency, but was beaten in the March elections by the entrenched rural political machines. On 3 October the revolution broke out simultaneously in Rio Grande do Sul, Minas Gerais and Paraíba, and on 3 November Vargas took office as head of the provisional government.

heading.zh-Hant: 臨時政府、新國家與1945年被罷黜
heading.en: Provisional government, the Estado Novo and his fall in 1945

body.zh-Hant: 臨時政府期間，他中止1891年憲法、解散國會與各州議會，並以只對他負責的幹事（interventor）取代民選州長，還設立了勞工部與教育部。1934年7月17日制憲會議選他為總統；1937年11月10日他與軍方發動政變，建立「新國家」（Estado Novo）。1942年巴西參戰，1944年派遠征軍赴義大利。1945年他廢除新聞審查、頒布新選舉法，但10月29日被軍方罷黜。
body.en: During the provisional government he suspended the 1891 Constitution, dismissed Congress and all the state legislatures, replaced elected governors with interventors answerable only to him, and created new ministries for labour and education. On 17 July 1934 the constituent assembly elected him president; on 10 November 1937 he and the armed forces staged the coup that created the Estado Novo. Brazil entered the war in 1942 and sent an expeditionary force to Italy in 1944. In 1945 he abolished censorship and issued a new electoral law, but the army deposed him on 29 October.

people.name: Tiburcio Carías Andino
people.nameZh: 蒂武西奧·卡里亞斯·安迪諾

heading.en: Origins, education and entry into party politics

body.zh-Hant: 蒂武西奧·卡里亞斯·安迪諾1876年3月15日生於特古西加爾巴，是卡利斯托·卡里亞斯將軍與薩拉·安迪諾的幼子。他1898年取得宏都拉斯中央大學法學學位，後來在國立學院教數學，也為貧童與工人授夜間課程。1891年起他就為自由黨助選；1903年他離開自由黨，支持曼努埃爾·博尼利亞創立國民黨；1907年他參與一場叛亂，因此獲得准將軍階。
body.en: Tiburcio Carías Andino was born on 15 March 1876 in Tegucigalpa, the youngest son of General Calixto Carías and Sara Andino. He took a law degree at the Central University of Honduras in 1898, later taught mathematics at the National Institute as well as night classes for poor children and workers. From 1891 he campaigned for the Liberal Party; in 1903 he left the Liberals to support Manuel Bonilla in founding the National Party, and his part in a 1907 revolt earned him the rank of brigadier general.

heading.zh-Hant: 國民黨領袖與1923至1928年選舉
heading.en: National Party leader and the elections of 1923–1928

body.zh-Hant: 卡里亞斯曾任議員與數個省的省長，成為國民黨領袖，並在1923年成為該黨總統候選人。他得票最多卻未達法定多數，國會無法解決僵局，他的武裝部隊於1924年攻佔特古西加爾巴。後來在美國調停下的選舉，由他的搭檔米格爾·帕斯·巴拉奧納當選總統。1928年他以約一萬二千票輸給自由黨，支持者要求起事，他卻接受官方結果，因此贏得廣泛尊重。
body.en: Carías served as a congressman and as governor of several departments, became leader of the National Party and in 1923 its presidential candidate. He won a plurality but lacked the required majority, Congress failed to resolve the stalemate, and his armed forces seized Tegucigalpa in 1924. In the subsequent elections, assisted by United States mediation, his running mate Miguel Paz Baraona was elected president. In 1928 he lost to the Liberals by twelve thousand votes and many supporters called for revolt, but he accepted the official result, a move that won him wide respect.

heading.zh-Hant: 任總統與卡里亞斯時期

body.zh-Hant: 1932年卡里亞斯在選舉中大勝何塞·安赫爾·蘇尼加·韋特，並在平定反對派叛亂後於1933年就任。1939年修憲使他得以先任至1944年，後來延至1949年。二戰期間他支持盟軍。1948年12月31日他終於卸任，把權力交給他的門生、戰爭部長胡安·曼努埃爾·加爾韋斯·杜龍。
body.en: In 1932 Carías won a convincing victory over José Ángel Zúñiga Huete and took office in 1933 after putting down an opposition revolt. Constitutional revisions in 1939 allowed him to stay first to 1944 and later through 1949. He supported the Allies in the Second World War. When he finally stepped down on 31 December 1948, he handed power to his protégé and minister of war, Juan Manuel Gálvez Durón.
